catches: No fixed dollar amount — earnings vary with participation and actual energy saved
Payout is variable gig-style reward, not guaranteed income
critical: Must be a PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E customer in California
Earnings vary with real energy reductions; nothing is guaranteed
eligibility: California resident with PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E electric service
Connect your utility account and participate in OhmHour / AutoOhm events
notes: Free to join. Watts can be withdrawn for cash or spent in the rewards marketplace. Official page states a concrete payout mechanism but no fixed dollar conversion.

steps: Sign up free and connect your California utility account
Reduce electricity use during OhmHour events when notified
Earn Watts for verified energy reductions
Withdraw Watts for cash or redeem in the rewards marketplace
timing: Watts accumulate per event; cash out via the platform per its payout schedule.
